name: Corporate control plane
description: Self-host so the org holds upstream keys, issues its own credentials, and can see per-seat usage. License must allow that internal service.

name: Credit or reroute
description: When a seat is out of credit or rate limit, sell or top up credit, or send the request to another model or key that still has capacity.

name: Codex and Claude Code
description: Same proxy can be the client endpoint for Codex (Responses API, tools, streaming) and Claude Code (Anthropic Messages).

name: Seat pool
description: Spread work across seats or API keys using live usage and limits (weights, cooldown, remaining quota), not round-robin alone.
